changelog: Fixed Video Export Pipeline Error with robust FFmpeg binary path discovery across system and bundled locations.
Resolved ASS subtitle and Brand Canvas temporary file path issues with absolute path escaping for Windows drive letters.
Added automatic detection for silent videos without audio tracks to prevent FFmpeg filtergraph stream mapping failures.
Upgraded Video Export Error Dialog with responsive sizing, scrollable log view, and one-click 'Copy Error' clipboard button.
Added comprehensive automated logging for export commands and errors (export_error.log).
Enhanced Gemini Chunked Transcribe with intelligent multi-segment processing for long audio/video files.
Integrated VoxCPM2 Tokenizer-Free Multilingual TTS & Voice Cloning engine with custom voice profiles.
